integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically; finite computation is used only as a consistency check. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact index formula is proved only for odd prime conductor and integral \(c\).
The \(c=1\) boundary generates the maximal real subfield and is explicitly excluded from the full-field formula.
The literature comparison is targeted; an older equivalent formula under alternate terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact prime-conductor index of \(\zeta+c\zeta^{-1}\)
